dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for the station names, domains, official submission path and SYN music mailbox before insertion. No prior Edge Radio 99.3FM or SYN Media music-submission opportunity was found. Each station was added once through its canonical first-party submission page. Edge Radio's digital email route, physical route, Tasmanian-only subject marker and optional paid promotion were consolidated into one editorial opportunity. SYN's music-submission mailbox was kept separate from its interview mailbox, and only the purpose-bound music address was queued.
emailVerificationLevel: SYN Media publishes music@syn.org.au in plaintext on its official Contact page specifically for music submissions. Verification covered valid syntax, exact stated purpose, first-party domain alignment and current official-site activity. Edge Radio's official Submit Your Music page publishes a dedicated music-email link, but Cloudflare protects the destination in the passive representation; it was not decoded, guessed or stored. Its interview and promotions contacts were not repurposed for music delivery. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, stream, download link, attachment, audio file, biography, metadata, rights declaration, personal information, physical package or payment was sent. No protected contact was decoded, no Tasmanian-local status was claimed, and no CAPTCHA, anti-bot, authentication, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
